text:
```yaml
name: Update NuGet Package Lock Json

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      prNumber:
        description: 'Pull request number to update lock files'
        required: true
  push:
    branches:
      - renovate/**

jobs:
  update-lock:
    uses: SonarSource/dotnet-tooling/.github/workflows/UpdateNugetPackageLockJson.yml@main
    with:
      solution: SonarScanner.MSBuild.sln
      restore-args: '--force-evaluate'
      prNumber: ${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && github.event.inputs.prNumber || '' }}
    secrets: inherit
```
